note: State written by a hand-run tick: `last_tick` is fresh, and there is no watcher record. This must read `dead`, not `live` — the trap being closed is that one field serving both facts would let a hand tick, or a human debugging, refresh the very heartbeat a supervisor consults, and a dead watch would then look alive for as long as somebody kept poking it. There is no cadence here to be late for, so no overdue event.
expect: note: RE-ARM from this state — do not reseed it. The next tick diffs against the stored observation and emits what accrued.
